column1: # Rule: a function is a function, with the clauses of one name and arity folded
# into one symbol at the first clause (area/1 and area/2 stay apart);
# -module(name). is a package; -type and -opaque are a type_alias;
# -record(name, {...}) is a class; -define(NAME, v). is a constant and
# -define(NAME(Args), body). is a function. Not definitions: -spec, -callback,
# -export, -import, -behaviour, record fields, a fun expression, calls.
